title: Phase 42: Assignment And Execution UAT
description: Validate that synced phase tasks can move from tracking to execution through configured agents, execution records, and safe status updates.
goal: Validate that synced phase tasks can move from tracking to execution through configured agents, execution records, and safe status updates.
successCriteria: `aof boards agents` lists configured board agents for the AOF project.
A synced phase task can be assigned to a configured agent when the selected execution path is safe.
Assignment writes an execution record and updates the task summary without corrupting board state.
Blocked, waiting, failed, and complete execution statuses can be inspected and updated.
If full live `runPhase()` execution is unsafe for the selected task, the boundary is documented and a controlled execution-status path is verified instead.
